blocks.text: Not every reason to return to a debate tournament has something to do with winning. Some tournaments are worth looking forward to. Others are worth coming back to. For those who have found their way to Luzon Intervarsity (LIV), the tournament has become both. Now in its 18th iteration, LIV continues to draw debaters and adjudicators from across the Philippines to University of the Philippines Los Baños (UPLB). Some come hoping to compete against the country’s top competitive debaters, while others return for the familiar faces and bonds established over the years.
